+## ZIP archival layout and completion
+
+New covers use a ten-digit zero-padded ID. The first four digits identify a
+million-cover archive.org item; the next two identify a 10,000-cover ZIP.
+For example, cover `0008819999` belongs to item `covers_0008` and batch `81`.
+Its medium image is stored as `0008819999-M.jpg` in
+`items/m_covers_0008/m_covers_0008_81.zip` and is available at
+`https://archive.org/download/m_covers_0008/m_covers_0008_81.zip/0008819999-M.jpg`.
+The same layout applies to the original, small, and large sizes, using no
+prefix, `s_`, and `l_` respectively. Image names use `-S`, `-M`, and `-L`.
+
+`archive.archive(test=False)` stages local images in uncompressed ZIP files
+and sets `archived=true` only after closing the ZIPs. It keeps local files
+until upload verification succeeds. Use
+`archive.Batch(item_id, batch_id).process_pending(upload=True, finalize=True, test=False)`
+to upload and verify all four ZIPs, set `uploaded=true`, replace each database
+filename with its download URL, and remove staged and local files. A per-batch
+lock prevents concurrent archival and finalization of the same ID range.
+`failed=true` identifies covers whose source files were missing. Retry the
+batch after restoring missing files and clearing that flag.
+
+The historical tar instructions below describe older cover records.

+## ZIP archival layout and completion
+
+New covers use a ten-digit zero-padded ID. The first four digits identify a
+million-cover archive.org item; the next two identify a 10,000-cover ZIP.
+For example, cover `0008819999` belongs to item `covers_0008` and batch `81`.
+Its medium image is stored as `0008819999-M.jpg` in
+`items/m_covers_0008/m_covers_0008_81.zip` and is available at
+`https://archive.org/download/m_covers_0008/m_covers_0008_81.zip/0008819999-M.jpg`.
+The same layout applies to the original, small, and large sizes, using no
+prefix, `s_`, and `l_` respectively. Image names use `-S`, `-M`, and `-L`.
+
+`archive.archive(test=False)` stages local images in uncompressed ZIP files
+and sets `archived=true` only after closing the ZIPs. It keeps local files
+until upload verification succeeds. Use
+`archive.Batch(item_id, batch_id).process_pending(upload=True, finalize=True, test=False)`
+to upload and verify all four ZIPs, set `uploaded=true`, replace each database
+filename with its download URL, and remove staged and local files. A per-batch
+lock prevents concurrent archival and finalization of the same ID range.
+`failed=true` identifies covers whose source files were missing. Retry the
+batch after restoring missing files and clearing that flag.
+
+The historical tar instructions below describe older cover records.
